info.title: Atlas Protocol
info.description: Atlas shared wire contract. 0.1.0 is exact, without version negotiation. Caller evidence and Core receipts are separate. Core owns atomic commits, authorization rechecks, ordering, timers and state transitions.

parameters.name: Atlas-Object-Descriptor
parameters.description: Unpadded base64url of UTF-8 UploadObjectDescriptor JSON. Bound before decoding. The body is its complete binary stream.

get.description: Authenticated discovery exception. Dataset and version request headers are optional.
WebSocket upgrade. First frame carries authentication, Dataset and exact version; no public data before authentication.

Counter.description: Canonical unsigned 64-bit decimal in 0..18446744073709551615, never a JSON number.

position_observed_at.description: Omission uses observed_at. Explicit null means the original time is unknown.

altitude_observed_at.description: Omission uses observed_at. Explicit null means the original time is unknown.

ground_speed_observed_at.description: Omission uses observed_at. Explicit null means the original time is unknown.

airspeed_observed_at.description: Omission uses observed_at. Explicit null means the original time is unknown.

PositiveCounter.description: Canonical unsigned 64-bit decimal in 0..18446744073709551615, never a JSON number.

Geometry.description: 2D GeoJSON. Maximum 1024 pairs including closure. No holes, crossings, multipart, date-line crossings or pole-spanning areas. Never repair or reorient. Point latitude +/-90 is valid.

CredentialFacts.description: Caller retains at least 32 cryptographically random bytes encoded base64url without padding. Core retains only the verifier. No role or scope fields.

MoveToGeofeature.description: Must resolve to a Point geometry at admission. Revision use is reported by the Asset, never inferred.

UploadObjectDescriptor.description: One descriptor plus the complete binary HTTP body. Byte length and SHA-256 must match streamed bytes. File admission is configurable Core policy, initially 2 GB.

PluginPayload.description: Only Plugin-owned capability input, output, and effect payloads may contain arbitrary JSON. The Plugin release owns validation against its independently published schema.

ContactChallenge.description: Exact retry recovers original expiry. Restart invalidates proof. Replacement binds expected_generation and commits its first check-in atomically.

ApiKey.description: Equal public permissions for every valid API key. Trusted gateways preserve original Asset/publisher attribution. No roles or Asset scopes.

Dataset.description: Actual Dataset for successes and declared errors.

Version.description: Actual Core Protocol version, including mismatch errors.

Error400.description: invalid_request, dataset_required, invalid_json, invalid_geometry, unsupported_geometry, geometry_limit_exceeded, unsupported_filter

Error409.description: protocol_mismatch, dataset_mismatch, identity_conflict, revision_conflict, generation_conflict, stale_evidence, asset_deleted, reference_guard, object_held, invalid_transition, queue_changed, challenge_invalid, challenge_expired, snapshot_expired, snapshot_released, replay_gap, capacity_changed, plugin_unavailable, unsupported_command

x-atlas-websocket.authentication: First client frame authenticates. No data before authentication. Core owns the bounded authentication timer. Credentials never enter URLs.
